info.title: Deepfake Literacy & Human-AI Evaluation API
info.description: Backend API powering Deepfake Literacy, Real vs Fake Multiplayer, Swin + DCT + Transformer Detection, and Explainable AI (XAI) Evaluation.

post.description:

and returns immediate educational explanation of the manipulation artifacts.

post.description:
Academic research protocol endpoint:
Records Human Verdict, Confidence (1-5), Clue Tags, and Reaction Time (ms).
Computes agreement with Swin + DCT + Transformer detector, determines 4-quadrant assignment,
generates XAI heatmap overlay, and stores in database.

get.description:
Computes academic KPIs, side-by-side confusion matrices, calibration plots,
and 4-quadrant disagreement distribution across all evaluations.

Returns submissions belonging to a specific quadrant (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4)
with item details and XAI explanation for granular error analysis.
